text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) TO BE INDUCTION HARDENED UPTO 45 ~ 55 HRC."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE:- 1)TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-30 HRc."}],"comment":"Note N1 requires induction hardening to 45–55 HRC while note N4 requires toughening to 28–30 HRc, which are contradictory heat-treatment instructions for the same part. This will confuse the heat treater and may result in incorrect hardness. The designer should clarify whether these apply to different zones or delete the incorrect requirement.","recommended_correction":"Resolve the contradiction by specifying which hardness applies where (e.g., surface vs core, or specific zones), or remove the incorrect note."}]}
